test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states/union territories was the first edition of the Himalayan Film Festival 2021 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **​The Himalayan Film Festival 2021**

 
 
• The union territory of **Ladakh** hosted the first edition of **The Himalayan Film Festival 2021 **(THFF) from September 24, 2021, to September 28, 2021, in **Leh capital city.**
 
• The five-day festival also created an interactive and exposure platform to promote aspiring local filmmakers and showcase Ladakh as an attractive film destination
 
• The festival is being organized by Leh in collaboration with the Directorate of Film Festivals under the Union Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• Popular films from the Himalayan states viz Assam, Sikkim, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Uttarakhand, Arunachal Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, and Ladakh besides Indian panorama selected films will be showcased during the festival
 
• Masterclasses and in-conversation sessions with renowned film personalities aimed at imparting necessary skills and networking opportunities to budding and established filmmakers were also organized during the festival.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ladakh** (UT) (As of May 2022)

 
 
• Capital: Leh
 
• Lieutenant Governor: Radha Krishna Mathur
